author: Azoz2
quote: A breathtaking, living open world with unmatched visual detail, a mature and gripping story, and gameplay that offers incredible freedom to explore and ****’s a complete masterpiece that sets a new industry standard and proves the long wait was worth every second. Easily deserves a 10/10!
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Azoz2
quote: Locked at 30 FPS with noticeable frame drops, a slow-paced story that loses momentum, clunky controls with bullet-sponge enemies, repetitive humor, and the same outdated, overly strict mission design.After a 13-year wait, reviewers seem afraid to break the hype—listing all these flaws yet still handing out 10/10s. Honestly, a 99/100 feels completely unfair.
